response.sql: SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.GOT) AS average_got, AVG(l.RBC) AS average_rbc, AVG(l.GOT) - o.overall_average_got AS got_difference FROM Laboratory AS l CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(GOT) AS overall_average_got FROM Laboratory) AS o WHERE o.overall_average_got IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.ID ORDER BY got_difference IS NULL, got_difference DESC LIMIT 10;
